three_sided_box_count: How many boxes currently have exactly three drawn sides?
Count the boxes that have exactly three sides already drawn.
How many box cells are one edge away from being completed?
Find the number of boxes with exactly three visible sides drawn.
How many boxes on the board have three drawn boundary edges?
capture_move_count: How many missing edges would complete at least one box if drawn?
Count the undrawn edge positions that would finish a box immediately.
How many possible next edge draws would capture a box right away?
Find the number of missing edges that complete one or more boxes.
How many gaps on the board are immediate box-completing moves?
highlighted_candidate_capture_count: Among the highlighted missing edges, how many would complete at least one box if drawn?
Count the highlighted gaps that would finish a box immediately.
How many highlighted candidate edges are box-completing moves?
Find the number of highlighted missing edges that complete one or more boxes.
Of the highlighted edge positions, how many would capture a box right away?
player_a_owned_box_count: How many boxes are marked with player A?
Count the boxes owned by player A.
How many completed boxes show an A mark?
Find the number of box cells marked A.
How many boxes on the board belong to player A?
player_b_owned_box_count: How many boxes are marked with player B?
Count the boxes owned by player B.

code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_player_a_owned_box_count: set "answer" to the number of boxes marked with player A
